ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- payload.contentDocumentId default (if (payload.parts.contentDocumentId != null) payload.parts.contentDocumentId.content as String else null)
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- payload.contentVersionId default (if (payload.parts.contentVersionId != null) payload.parts.contentVersionId.content as String else null)
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- attributes.queryParams.matterId default payload.matterId default (if (payload.parts.matterId != null) payload.parts.matterId.content as String else null)

salesforce:query.doc:name: Query file metadata
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Title, FileExtension, PathOnClient, FileType, ContentDocumentId FROM ContentVersion WHERE Id = ':contentVersionId'

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import withMaxSize from dw::core::Strings var rawName = (payload.Title[0] default "Bill") ++ ("." ) ++ (payload.FileExtension[0] default "pdf") --- withMaxSize((rawName replace /[^a-zA-Z0-9.]/ with "_"), 80)

http:request.doc:name: Login Salesforce REST
http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/x-www-form-urlencoded --- { grant_type: "client_credentials", client_id: p("salesforce.clientId"), client_secret: p("salesforce.clientSecret") }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: if (vars.idpPackageId != null) "Success" else "Error", message: if (vars.idpPackageId != null) "Extraction complete and sent for review" else "Extraction ran but the review records could not be created; see the Mule log", idpStatus: vars.idpResult.status default null, idpPackageId: vars.idpPackageId default null, idpDocumentTypeId: vars.idpDocumentTypeId default null, matterId: vars.matterId default null, documentName: (vars.idpResult.documentName default vars.FullFileName) default null, correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Package Created
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "action": "IDP_PACKAGE_CREATED", "idpPackageId": vars.idpPackageId, "matterId": vars.matterId, "correlationId": correlationId, "idpStatus": vars.idpResult.status }]

try.doc:name: Try Link Source File To Document Type

choice.doc:name: Choice Link Only If ContentDocument Known

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { ContentDocumentId: vars.resolvedContentDocumentId, LinkedEntityId: vars.idpDocumentTypeId, ShareType: "V", Visibility: "AllUsers" }

logger.doc:name: Log No ContentDocument To Link
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "action": "SKIP_IDP_DOCUMENT_TYPE_FILE_LINK", "reason": "No ContentDocumentId resolved from the ContentVersion or the request; the reviewer will have no PDF on this document type.", "idpDocumentTypeId": vars.idpDocumentTypeId }]

logger.doc:name: Log File Link Error
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "action": "IDP_DOCUMENT_TYPE_FILE_LINK_ERROR", "errorType": error.errorType.identifier, "description": error.description, "idpDocumentTypeId": vars.idpDocumentTypeId, "contentDocumentId": vars.resolvedContentDocumentId }]
